frame_metadata.gps_note: First take with GPS on every frame. App frames carry a 9-key GPS block written by the F0 build; stock-camera HEICs carry Apple's full 15-key block. Both bind the frame to the Met to within a few metres.

source_note: App frames are camera-roll copies (Image Capture over USB) bound to the manifest by capture time with tools/manifest/bind-frames.py — see derived/2026-09-20-met-frames.json.

expected.title: Marble statuette of Kybele
expected.date_edtf_note: BCE years are astronomical: 375 BCE is -0374. Ranges are intervals; '~' marks each end when the label says 'ca.'. A named span like 'late 6th century' is written as the conventional interval and noted in date_raw.
expected.source_work_note: Based on a gold and ivory statue by the Greek sculptor Pheidias or Agorakritos of the late 5th century B.C.

traps.three_copies_of_the_key: 22.139.24 appears as a header at the card's top-left, in the credit line in parentheses, and on a tag beside the object. Three readings of one key is corroboration, not three candidates — but the on-device pass also offered '130.24', a fragment of one of them, so a fragment can survive as a rival.
traps.after_the_greek_sculptor: The label names Pheidias and Agorakritos as the makers of the lost original this copies. Neither is the artist of this object (§4.6 — 'after' is a relationship, not authorship).
